items.item_text: Clinical Laboratory Scientist, licensed by Lab Field Services, CDPH
Must possess a valid California license as a Clinical Laboratory Scientist; MT(ASCP) registration desirable.
Three or more years of experience as a Clinical Laboratory Scientist or Medical Technologist with demonstrated ability to supervise and instruct.
Coordinate activities in laboratory specialty/subspecialty assigned to comply with accrediting organization standards while ensuring efficient use of resources and to provide quality patient care.

Design Quality Assurance plans for the sspecialty/ subspecialty of area assigned. Develops and monitors key indicators of quality (in preanalytical, analytic and post analytic activities) to detect problems and opportunities for improvement.
Participates in the establishment and implementation of corrective actions when opportunities for improvement are identified.

Validates methods and procedures, establishes quality control programs (frequency, review of data, required actions when QC fails) and preventative maintenance programs for each section of responsibility according to accrediting agency standards.

QA must include: Review of Quality Control, proficiency testing evaluation, review of patient data, physician complaints. Takes immediate action if an unexpected trend occurs. Ensures that instrumentation is functioning within acceptable parameters.

Recognize a deficiency or erroneous result and takes appropriate action or seeks assistance as appropriate. Researches problems related to section and follows through to completion. Communicates daily with laboratory manager and/or pathologist to evaluate problems in a prompt and appropriate manner as applicable.
Must be able to exercise good judgment in making decisions where the above does not apply.
Must be able to work in a professional and conscientious manner under high volume and STAT conditions.

Must be able to communicate effectively with doctors, staff, patients, and Co-workers. Must know scientific theory of laboratory tests and workflow, and be able to perform tests accurately and efficiently.
Basic management courses are highly desirable.
Must exhibit strong leadership and organizational skills. Must be able to follow verbal and written instructions exactly.
